claim: Deliveries: Kroger Boost vs Instacart Express : r/kroger - Reddit
summary: By using Kroger BOOST instead of IC Express, I save $400 per year, Regarding refunds (missing, wrong, or spoiled items -- which are infrequent) and for misapplied digital coupons and sales items not priced correctly -- a larger issue thus far , Kroger has a better system than IC, IMO.
